description: Single source of truth for which preview concepts are published to the live Firebase Hosting site (awe-concepts-previews). scripts/publish-selected-previews.mjs prunes the built output to EXACTLY the entries listed here with status "active". A slug must never be published merely because it appears in prospect research — it is added here only after individual business + no-existing-website verification. Archived source directories under preview/<slug>/ stay in GitHub but must never appear here.
policy: Only individually verified, no-independent-website-found concepts are published live. All other source directories remain archived in GitHub and excluded from live Hosting, the public index, the sitemap and the preview manifest.
